source: Family names by municipality, 1 January 2026 (Statbel, TA_POP_LST_2026)
note: The national total, summed from Statbel's per-municipality table. Belgium publishes the grain this atlas actually wants — surname, commune, count — and the per-commune rows are kept in data/belgium-by-municipality.json rather than flattened away here. A name is counted once per commune it appears in, so summing is correct; Statbel suppresses the smallest counts, which is why this total is short of the population.
